annotation.title_clean: Umelá inteligencia | Shaping Europe's digital future
annotation.title_en: Artificial Intelligence | Shaping Europe's digital future
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Commission (DG CONNECT), Shaping Europe's digital future
annotation.summary_en: Slovak-language European Commission portal page on EU AI policy. It presents the risk-based AI Act, the April 2025 AI Continent Action Plan, the Apply AI Strategy, AI factories and gigafactories, and the European AI Office created in June 2024, framing the approach as promoting innovation while keeping AI safe and trustworthy.
key_provisions_or_claims: AI Act introduces an innovation-friendly risk-based approach to build trust in AI
AI Continent Action Plan adopted by the Commission in April 2025 to strengthen AI capabilities
Apply AI Strategy promotes AI adoption in strategic sectors and the public sector with an 'AI first' policy
European AI Office, established June 2024, implements and enforces the AI Act
Investment in AI factories, gigafactories and supercomputer access for startups and researchers
